description: (0.5.0, Draft) Shape of the io.acdp/provenance value (RFC-ACDP-0019 §6; schema $defs/provenance).

input.note: Run the proxy in front of a stub MCP server that returns the mcp-001 CallToolResult for tools/call regional_fraud_rate, against a test registry.

expected.behavior: Value is {ctx_id, content_hash, registry, salt}; ctx_id and content_hash equal the publish response; registry equals the body's origin_registry; salt decodes (base64url, unpadded) to exactly 32 bytes.
salt is absent exactly when the record's salted is false.
The proxy never returns a ctx_id before the registry's publish response carrying it has been received.

A consumer holding the returned result retrieves ctx_id, verifies the body per RFC-ACDP-0001 §5.11, checks agent_id is a proxy it trusts, recomputes result_hash with the salt and accepts; a single changed byte of content makes the result_hash check fail.
